mechanism.cognitive_path: direct continuous sensor/action/outcome to GRUCell factual state, then exogenous and action-effect heads
mechanism.architecture_limitation: GRUCell is conventional recurrence, so token-free is not novel architecture or conventional-baseline superiority

local_engineering.first_smoke_training: 80 Adam steps on same authored development fixture, not independent science

science.hypothesis: Learnable hidden causal-state after factual interventions improves unfamiliar noisy latent-mode control and cold retention beyond strongest P42 and GRU/MLP controls under equal information/actions/compute
pre_first_use: new source-born unseen splits/seeds and hash
owner authorization and exact checkpoint custody
fully trained history GRU and MLP, P42 LSQ, ABA, last-effect EMA, sham/disabled-memory
same action and observation histories for all learner arms
cold retention, hidden-mode reversal, interference and unfamiliar-world transfer
negative quadratic drift and shuffled outcome controls
preset effect sizes, uncertainty and no post-result tuning
science.caveat: Tokenless source+interfaces, but using a conventional GRUCell gives no demonstrated breakthrough beyond controls
